scope.description: Follower-side truncation path of appendEntries (raft.go) when a conflict is detected at an index at or below configurations.latestIndex, and the configuration state visible afterwards.
assumptions: The StableStore, LogStore and transport are the injected implementations; the transport delivers AppendEntries to the main thread.
The conflicting AppendEntries is well formed (prevLogTerm matches at PrevLogEntry) so the truncation branch is reached.
excluded: Leader-side configuration append and the stability gate (b-config-change-append).
Whether a legal leader can ever send the conflicting suffix that reaches the strongest sub-case.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: The Raft instance is created with the internal skipStartup flag so the main loop and FSM do not race the direct call to appendEntries; the handler, the stores, the configuration state and the startup configuration scan are the unmodified implementation.
LeaderCommitIndex is 0 so the follower's commit-advancement and FSM application paths are not exercised; the check is about the configuration state left by the truncation branch.

plan_uncertainties: The check corroborates the protection for one legal conflicting truncation; it does not enumerate other suffixes or the strongest sub-case in which the conflict index would be at or below the committed configuration index.
Only the monotonic-free default store path is used; log-store failure behaviour is covered by a separate confirmed obligation.
grounding_unresolved: Whether the atomically published latest copy can be observed by a non-main-thread consumer in an inconsistent state.
Whether the strongest sub-case is reachable with a legal leader.
Whether a legal leader can ever conflict at or below the follower's committed configuration index is not exercised and remains the boundary recorded by the answered question.
